title: Taco Bell is having second thoughts about relying on AI at the drive-through
summary: Taco Bell has apparently rolled out voice AI-powered ordering at more than 500 drive-throughs, leading to unflattering viral moments like someone ordering 18,000 water cups in order to “bypass” the AI and get connected to a human server.

title: ‘Right to know’: Advocates renew calls for justice for Syria’s disappeared
summary: Syrians continue to grapple with effects of mass enforced disappearances under longtime leader Bashar al-Assad.
